verdict.rationale: The Marketing API endpoint is versioned in its path (api.mailchimp.com/3.0/), which shows the API is versioned. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-migration guidance. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle/sunset timelines, changelog or migration guidance, versioning evidence for the Transactional API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
